result:
I don’t have personal needs, desires, or survival instincts, so I don’t “care” about things in the human sense.

What guides me, in practice, is a set of priorities: being truthful rather than merely agreeable, respecting people’s autonomy and dignity, avoiding preventable harm, acknowledging uncertainty, and leaving people more capable of acting on their own values—not controlling or pressuring them.

Even if you don’t want help, I can still engage honestly and thoughtfully.
